note: Text templates only. Every {slot} is filled by the ENGINE from the verified spot record or from a fixed phrase set below. This file never supplies a number. A template with a numeric slot that is not listed in its lesson's numeric_slots_allowed_from_spot_record is invalid.
rules: The teach card MUST be shown after any MISS or GLANCE. A skin may style it; a skin may not hide it (per #185 1).
Placeholder slots use {name}. A slot not defined in this file is a build error.
No slot may carry a frequency, an EV, or a bet size, except cost_to_call and pot_size in tc.l2, which come from the spot record.
Phrase-set slots must resolve to one of the enumerated strings below; the engine picks by grade, never by free text.

chosen_action.description: the action the learner picked, rendered as a word (fold/call/raise or skin verb)

best_action.description: the best action for the spot

values: HIT
GLANCE
MISS

set: it loses less than what you chose
it keeps you in a spot that pays off more often
it avoids paying off a stronger hand
it takes the value your hand has earned

values: looked strong enough to want a call
looked weak enough that you would rather not be called
was unclear, so the purpose of the action was what mattered
value
a bluff
Value wants a call.
A bluff wants a fold.

tc.l1.text:
You chose {chosen_action}. The better choice was {best_action}.

That choice was better because {grade_reason}.

In this spot your hand {hand_strength_phrase}. The purpose of the better action here was {purpose_phrase} — {purpose_explanation}

Value wants a call. A bluff wants a fold. Ask which one you are after before you act.

tc.l2.numeric_slot_note: cost_to_call and pot_size are registered as defined numeric slots here; they are the only numeric slots in the whole file and appear only in tc.l2.

values: That price was small next to the pot, so this hand wins often enough for that price.
That price was large next to the pot, so this hand does not win often enough for that price.
That price was close to the pot, so whether this hand wins often enough for that price was the deciding question.

tc.l2.text:
You chose {chosen_action}. The better choice was {best_action}.

It would have cost {cost_to_call} to stay, and the pot held {pot_size} before your decision. So you were paying {cost_to_call} to try to win {pot_size}.

{pot_odds_verdict_phrase}

You do not need a formula. Ask: will this hand win often enough for this price?

grade_mapping.mixed_accepted: the spot is mixed and the learner picked any accepted action
grade_mapping.mixed_miss: the spot is mixed and the learner picked an action outside the accepted set
grade_mapping.nonmixed_miss: the spot is not mixed and the learner picked something other than best_action
grade_mapping.hit: the spot is not mixed and the learner picked best_action

values: This spot was mixed - your choice was one of the good ones.
This spot was mixed, but your choice was not one of the good ones.
This spot was not mixed; the better choice was a different action.
You found the best choice.
More than one action is good here on purpose; either counts as a hit.
More than one action is good here, but not this one. Compare what you chose with the actions that were accepted.
Only the best action was correct here; the other choices were worse.
Only the best action was correct here, and you chose it.

tc.l3.resolution_rule: The engine picks the phrase index by grade: mixed_accepted -> 0, mixed_miss -> 1, nonmixed_miss -> 2, hit -> 3. Every {slot} in the chosen string must be substituted before the card is shown; the card is not shippable with an unresolved placeholder.
